rows.grounds: numeral forming first member of compound with patra
second member of compound describing number of petals

items.question: What form and regal status characterize the sixth cakra?
premises: The sixth cakra is the subject of description.
This cakra is characterized as royal.
This cakra possesses eight petals and a pericarp.
items.inference: The sixth cakra is a royal center with eight petals and a pericarp.
uncertainties: rājānam may function as a metaphorical epithet or a more literal designation.
items.plain_english: But the sixth cakra is royal, having eight petals and a pericarp.
